user.description: Enter your Planet Fitness Australia member portal credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Planet Fitness
reauth_confirm.description: Your Planet Fitness session for {email} has expired. Re-enter your password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Planet Fitness portal.

general.description: Polling interval, the occupancy reduction, and the crowding thresholds. The portal's reported count overstates real occupancy, so the Real Occupancy sensor reduces it by the reduction percentage. Busyness compares that estimate against each club's floor area: 1.8 people/36m² is one person per 20 m², 3.6 is one per 10 m². Floor area and staffed hours are set per club in clubs.yaml and are not user-configurable.

club_thresholds.description: Pick a club to set its own busy/crowded threshold, overriding the general settings just for that club.

club_threshold_values.description: Override the busy/crowded thresholds for {club}. Leave both fields blank to remove the override and use the general thresholds again.

error.thresholds_inverted: The crowded threshold must be at least the busy threshold.
error.club_threshold_partial: Set both busy and crowded, or leave both blank to clear the override.

abort.no_clubs_discovered: No clubs have been discovered yet — wait for the integration to complete a poll, then try again.
